## Ruling recorded — **retire both zero-author registrations, `kanban-enhanced` and `kanban-ui`** (maintainer, 2026-09-09)

`domain:spec` @ objectui PM seat, session `session_01Jmxdo7bmeqCQHLSfmLVX9w`. Asked directly with the measurement below in the question. ⇒ This card leaves the decision box and is dispatchable.

⭐ Note the ruling went **wider than this card asked**. The card asks only whether `kanban-enhanced` gets a declared arm; the answer is that it gets **no arm and no registration**, and `kanban-ui` goes with it, for the same measured reason.

## The measurement

Exact node-type spellings, whole repo, `origin/main`:

| spelling | JSON documents | TS/TSX | registered? |
|---|---|---|---|
| **`kanban-enhanced`** | **0** | **0** | ✅ `plugin-kanban/src/index.tsx:351` |
| **`kanban-ui`** | **0** | **0** | ✅ `:252` |
| bare `kanban` | 3 | 38 | ✅ `:589` — **also being retired**, objectui#8802 |
| `object-kanban` | 0 | — | ✅ `:579` — the survivor |
| **control** `object-grid` | 2 | 128 | — |
| **control** `zzz-not-a-type` | 0 | — | — |

Two controls behaving: a real sibling fires at 130 sites, an absent name is silent. ⇒ **both zeros are readings.**

⇒ Two registered type keys that **no document in this repository has ever authored, in either language.** Declaring an arm for either would commit the repo to maintaining a validation face for a spelling with no writers — the opposite of what ADR-0049 enforce-or-remove asks.

## ⚠️ `kanban-ui` is NOT a free deletion — read objectui#8818 first

This is the part the implementing seat must not discover late. **objectui#8818** (filed today) measured that on the **`kanban-ui`** entry an authored `objectFields` still reaches the predicate layer:

- `SchemaRenderer.tsx` strips a **fixed, enumerated** metadata list (`:1455-1481`) and spreads the rest as React props. `objectFields` appears in that file **0 times** (grep exit 1; firing control `className` → 22), so it is not stripped.
- `KanbanRenderer` — registered for **`kanban-ui`** — now declares `objectFields` as a real prop (`plugin-kanban/src/index.tsx:217`).
- PR #8799 measured the consequence end-to-end: `kanban-ui` + authored `objectFields` ⇒ the card is **painted**; the same on a `kanban` node ⇒ unpainted.

⇒ **Retiring the `kanban-ui` registration closes that hole as a side effect.** That is a good outcome, but it means:

1. ⛔ **objectui#8818 must not be ruled independently after this lands** — its four options (strip at the `SchemaRenderer` boundary / refuse by name / declare and judge / accept and pin) are largely mooted for this entry by the registration going away.
2. The implementing seat should **say so on #8818** rather than leaving a card describing a hole that no longer exists.
3. ⚠️ #8818's option (a) — stripping `objectFields` at the `SchemaRenderer` boundary — would have closed the **class**, not just this entry. Retiring the registration closes only this entry. **If another renderer ever declares an `objectFields` prop, the hole returns.** Worth one sentence in the retirement's changeset so the next reader knows the class is still open.

## `kanban-enhanced`'s own residue

The card's framing is that its registration reads `onColumnToggle` / `enableVirtualScrolling` / `virtualScrollThreshold` with no declared arm. ⚠️ **objectui#8257 is not the only card on those keys** — PR #8799's body records that objectui#8257 carries them and that they were deliberately out of scope there. With the registration retired, those three keys have no authorable surface at all, which resolves the card's question by removing its subject. ⛔ The implementing seat should confirm that reading rather than assume it.

## Mechanism, same as every retirement in this family

⚠️ `BaseSchema` is `.passthrough()` ⇒ a **dropped** key is *kept*, not refused. If any schema face declares these type names, the retirement needs a **named refusal** (`retirementTombstone` + `?: never`) with compile-time pins, not a deletion — the objectui#7664 failure, and the pattern PR #8799 executed correctly.

## Sequence with the family — ⛔ do not race these into the same files

| card | ruling |
|---|---|
| **this card** | retire `kanban-enhanced` + `kanban-ui` |
| **objectui#8802** | retire the bare `kanban` node key |
| **objectui#8008** | retire the bare `gantt` registration |

All three land in `packages/plugin-kanban/src/index.tsx`, `packages/types/src/complex.ts` and `zod/complex.zod.ts` (the first two at least). **One dispatch touching all of the kanban family at once is safer than three racing slices** — and the maintainer ruled the family in one batch, which is the signal to implement it that way.
